10 Best Recipes for Chicken Soup in Crockpot (Easy & Comforting)

When it comes to comfort food, nothing compares to a warm, hearty bowl of chicken soup. And when you combine that classic recipe with the convenience of a crockpot or slow cooker, you get a winning dish that requires minimal effort but delivers maximum flavor. Whether you’re craving a classic crockpot chicken noodle soup, a creamy chicken soup crockpot version, or a nourishing crockpot chicken vegetable soup, the slow cooker is your best friend for creating soups that are comforting, healthy, and satisfying.

In this guide, you’ll find the 10 best recipes for chicken soup in a crockpot, covering different variations such as chicken rice soup crockpot, crockpot chicken and potato soup, and even how to make homemade chicken soup in a slow cooker using different cuts like chicken breast, chicken thighs, or even a crockpot whole chicken soup. Along the way, we’ll also answer common questions such as:

  • Can you put raw chicken in a crockpot for soup?

  • How long does chicken soup take to cook in a crockpot?

  • Is it better to cook chicken on high or low in a crockpot?

  • Do you need to cook chicken before putting it in a slow cooker?

  • How do you thicken chicken soup in a crockpot?

  • Can you freeze crockpot chicken soup?

  • What is the best cut of chicken for crockpot soup?

  • Can I add noodles to chicken soup in a crockpot?

  • How do you make crockpot chicken soup creamy?

  • Can I use frozen chicken for crockpot chicken soup?

Let’s dive into each recipe step by step, ensuring you’ll be able to make them at home with ease.

The Basics of Crockpot Chicken Soup

Before we explore the recipes, let’s cover the essential ingredients and cooking principles that make crockpot chicken soup a staple in many kitchens.

Key Ingredients

  • Chicken: You can use chicken breast, chicken thighs, or bone-in chicken for richer flavor.

  • Chicken broth / stock: Provides depth of flavor. Homemade or store-bought works.

  • Vegetables: Carrots, celery, onion, garlic, and potatoes are common.

  • Herbs: Fresh or dried parsley, thyme, rosemary, and bay leaf enhance aroma.

  • Carbohydrates: Noodles/pasta, rice, or potatoes.

  • Seasoning: Salt, pepper, paprika, and sometimes lemon juice for brightness.

  • Cream / milk: For creamy versions.

Crockpot Cooking Tips

  • Always place vegetables at the bottom since they cook slower.

  • Chicken can be added raw or frozen, depending on your schedule.

  • Cooking on low brings out deeper flavors, while high is quicker but may result in slightly different textures.

Recipe 1: Classic Crockpot Chicken Noodle Soup

This crockpot chicken noodle soup is the ultimate comfort food.

Ingredients

  • 2 chicken breasts (or chicken thighs)

  • 2 cups chicken broth / stock

  • 2 carrots, sliced

  • 2 stalks celery, chopped

  • 1 onion, diced

  • 3 cloves garlic, minced

  • 2 cups noodles / pasta

  • 1 tsp thyme, 1 bay leaf, salt, pepper

  • Fresh parsley for garnish

Step-by-Step Process

Step 1: Prepare the Vegetables

Description: Place sliced carrots, chopped celery, diced onion, and minced garlic at the bottom of the crockpot.

 

Step 2: Add Chicken and Broth

Description: Lay chicken breasts on top of the vegetables and pour chicken broth over everything.

 

Step 3: Season the Soup

Description: Add thyme, bay leaf, salt, and pepper to the crockpot for flavor.

Cook on low for 6–7 hours or high for 3–4 hours.

Step 4: Slow Cook

Description: Cover the crockpot and cook on low for 6–7 hours or high for 3–4 hours until the chicken is tender.

 

Step 5: Shred the Chicken

Description: Remove the cooked chicken breasts, shred them using two forks, and return the shredded chicken to the soup.

 

Step 6: Add Noodles

Description: Stir in the noodles and cook for an additional 20–30 minutes until they are tender.

 

Step 7: Garnish and Serve

Description: Garnish with fresh parsley and serve the warm, comforting crockpot chicken noodle soup.

Recipe 2: Healthy Chicken Soup Crockpot Style

This healthy chicken soup crockpot recipe skips cream and keeps sodium low.

Ingredients

  • 2 chicken thighs, skinless

  • 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth

  • 2 carrots, 2 stalks celery

  • 1 onion, chopped

  • 1 cup rice

  • Herbs: rosemary, thyme, parsley

  • Salt, pepper, paprika

Step-by-Step Process

Step 1: Layer Vegetables and Rice

Description: Place chopped carrots, celery, onion, and rice at the bottom of the slow cooker.

 

Step 2: Add Chicken Thighs and Broth

Description: Place skinless chicken thighs on top of the vegetable and rice layer, then pour low-sodium chicken broth over everything.

 

Step 3: Season with Herbs and Spices

Description: Season the ingredients with rosemary, thyme, parsley, salt, pepper, and paprika.

 

Step 4: Cook on Low

Description: Cover the crockpot and cook on low for 7–8 hours until the chicken is thoroughly cooked and vegetables are tender

 

Step 5: Shred Chicken and Stir

Description: Remove the cooked chicken thighs, shred them, and stir back into the soup with the cooked rice and vegetables before serving.

Recipe 3: Creamy Chicken Soup Crockpot

For lovers of rich and hearty soups, this creamy chicken soup crockpot recipe is irresistible.

Ingredients

  • 2 chicken breasts

  • 2 cups chicken stock

  • 1 cup cream / milk

  • 2 potatoes, diced

  • 1 onion, 2 carrots, 2 stalks celery

  • 2 cloves garlic

  • Thyme, parsley

  • Salt, pepper, paprika

Steps

Step 1: Prepare and Add Ingredients to Crockpot

Description: First, gather all your fresh vegetables and chicken breasts. Dice the potatoes, chop the onion, carrots, and celery, and mince the garlic. Place all these ingredients, along with the chicken, into your crockpot.

 

Step 2: Pour in Chicken Stock and Season with Herbs

Description: Next, pour two cups of chicken stock over the ingredients in the crockpot. Season generously with thyme, parsley, salt, pepper, and paprika. These herbs and spices will infuse the soup with delicious flavor as it cooks.

 

Step 3: Cook on Low for 6 Hours

Description: Cover your crockpot and set it to cook on low for 6 hours. This slow cooking method will ensure the chicken becomes incredibly tender and the vegetables are perfectly soft, allowing all the flavors to meld together beautifully.

 

Step 4: Add Cream and Stir

Description: Once the 6 hours are up, open the crockpot. You can shred the chicken breasts right in the pot if desired. Then, pour in one cup of cream or milk and stir everything together until well combined. The cream will give the soup its signature rich and velvety texture.

 

Step 5: Adjust Seasoning and Serve with Bread

Description: Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning with additional salt, pepper, or herbs if needed. Serve your delicious creamy chicken soup hot, garnished with a sprinkle of fresh parsley, and accompanied by some crusty bread for dipping. Enjoy your menumoments.com creation!

Recipe 7: Best Crockpot Chicken Soup Recipe

When people ask for the best crockpot chicken soup recipe, it’s usually about balance.

When people ask for the best crockpot chicken soup recipe, it’s usually about balance — tender chicken, hearty vegetables, perfectly cooked starches, and a broth that’s full of depth and comfort.

Ingredients

  • 2 bone-in chicken thighs (or chicken breast if preferred)

  • 6 cups chicken broth / stock

  • 2 carrots, sliced

  • 2 stalks celery, chopped

  • 1 onion, diced

  • 3 cloves garlic, minced

  • 1 cup rice or noodles / pasta (choose based on preference)

  • 2 potatoes, diced (optional for extra thickness)

  • Herbs: 1 tsp thyme, 1 tsp rosemary, 1 bay leaf, fresh parsley

  • Juice of ½ lemon

  • Salt, pepper, paprika to taste

Step-by-Step Process

Step 1: Prepare the Base

Chop all vegetables (carrots, celery, onion, garlic, potatoes) and place them at the bottom of the crockpot. This ensures they cook evenly.

 

Step 2: Add the Chicken

Place the bone-in chicken thighs (or chicken breast) on top of the vegetables. Using bone-in adds extra flavor to the broth, making this recipe especially rich.

 

Step 3: Pour in the Broth

Add chicken broth or stock until the ingredients are fully covered. Stir in the thyme, rosemary, and bay leaf. Sprinkle with a little paprika, salt, and pepper.

 

Step 4: Slow Cook

Cover the crockpot and cook on low for 7–8 hours or high for 4–5 hours. The chicken should be tender and easily shred with a fork.

Prefer fewer ingredients with the same cozy payoff? Our stoved chicken (Scottish stovies) walks you through a minimal-prep, one-pot method that nails weeknight comfort.

Step 5: Add Starch

About 30 minutes before serving, add your chosen starch — either rice or noodles/pasta. If you’re adding potatoes, they should already be in from the beginning.

 

Step 6: Shred the Chicken

Remove chicken from the crockpot, discard bones (if using bone-in), and shred the meat. Return shredded chicken to the soup and stir.

 

Step 7: Brighten the Flavor

Just before serving, squeeze in the juice of half a lemon and sprinkle with fresh parsley. This adds a fresh, vibrant touch.

 

 

Step 8: Serve and Enjoy


Ladle into bowls, garnish with extra parsley if desired, and serve hot with crusty bread.

Recipe 8: Crockpot Chicken Soup with Frozen Chicken

If you forgot to thaw meat, crockpot chicken soup with frozen chicken works too.

Ingredients:

  • 1.5 – 2 lbs boneless, skinless frozen chicken breasts or thighs

  • 6-8 cups chicken broth

  • 2 cups mixed frozen vegetables (carrots, peas, corn, green beans)

  • 1 onion, chopped (optional)

  • 2 cloves garlic, minced (optional)

  • 1 tsp dried thyme

  • 1/2 tsp dried rosemary

  • Salt and black pepper to taste

  • Fresh parsley for garnish (optional)

  • Egg noodles or rice (optional, for serving)

Step-by-Step Process

Step 1: Place frozen chicken directly into the crockpot.

 

Step 2: Add broth, vegetables, and seasoning.

 

Step 3: Cook on high for 5–6 hours or low for 8–9 hours.

 

Step 4: Shred chicken before serving.

Recipe 9: Low Sodium Crockpot Chicken Soup

Perfect for those watching their salt intake.

Ingredients:

  • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts

  • 8 cups low-sodium chicken broth

  • 2 cups chopped carrots

  • 2 cups chopped celery

  • 1 cup chopped onion

  • 1 tablespoon dried parsley

  • 1 teaspoon dried thyme

  • 1/2 teaspoon black pepper

  • 2 bay leaves

  • 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice

  • (Optional) 1 cup cooked whole wheat pasta or brown rice

Step-by-Step Process

Step 1: Gather Your Low-Sodium Broth and Ingredients

Start by assembling all your ingredients, making sure to use a low-sodium chicken broth as the foundation for this heart-healthy soup. This step is crucial for controlling the overall sodium content.

 

Step 2: Combine Broth, Chicken, and Vegetables in Crockpot

Place the boneless, skinless chicken breasts at the bottom of your crockpot. Add the low-sodium chicken broth, chopped carrots, celery, and onion. These vegetables will slowly cook down, releasing their natural sweetness and nutrients into the soup.

 

Step 3: Season with Herbs (No Salt Needed!)

Instead of salt, generously season your soup with a fragrant blend of dried parsley, dried thyme, and black pepper. Add a couple of bay leaves for an extra layer of aromatic depth. These herbs will infuse the soup with incredible flavor without increasing the sodium content.

 

Step 4: Cook on Low for Several Hours

Cover your crockpot and cook on low for 6-8 hours, or on high for 3-4 hours, until the chicken is tender and easily shredded. The slow cooking process allows the flavors to meld beautifully and the vegetables to soften perfectly.

 

Step 5: Shred Chicken and Add Lemon Juice

Once cooked, remove the chicken breasts and shred them using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the crockpot. Now, add the fresh lemon juice. This brightens the flavor of the soup and provides a zesty finish, perfectly complementing the herbs. If desired, stir in cooked whole wheat pasta or brown rice at this stage.

 

Step 6: Serve and Enjoy Your Healthy Soup!

Ladle the hot Low Sodium Crockpot Chicken Soup into bowls. Garnish with a sprinkle of fresh parsley if you like. This comforting and healthy soup is now ready to be enjoyed!

Recipe 10: Gluten Free Chicken Soup Crockpot

If you’re avoiding gluten, swap noodles for rice or potatoes.

Ingredients:

  • 1-1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs

  • 1 cup uncooked rice (or diced potatoes for a change)

  • 4 cups mixed vegetables (carrots, celery, peas, corn, etc.)

  • 8 cups gluten-free chicken broth

  • 1 tsp dried herbs (such as thyme, oregano, or a poultry blend)

  • Salt and pepper to taste

Step-by-Step Process

Step 1. Add chicken, rice, vegetables, broth, and herbs to the crockpot.

 

Step 2. Cook on low for 6-7 hours, or until chicken is cooked through and rice is tender.

 

Step 3. Adjust seasoning (salt and pepper to taste) and serve warm.

 

Step 4. Carefully remove the chicken from the crockpot and shred it using two forks. Return the shredded chicken to the soup.

 

Step 5. Ladle the hot soup into bowls. Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired, for an extra burst of flavor and color.

Crockpot Whole Chicken Soup

You can even make crockpot whole chicken soup. Place a whole chicken in your slow cooker with vegetables and herbs, then strain and shred once cooked.

Homemade Chicken Soup in Slow Cooker

The beauty of homemade chicken soup in a slow cooker is the hands-off method. Just combine ingredients, set the timer, and let it simmer into perfection.

FAQs About Crockpot Chicken Soup

Can you put raw chicken in a crockpot for soup?

Yes, raw chicken is safe to add and will cook thoroughly.

How long does chicken soup take to cook in a crockpot?

Typically 6–8 hours on low or 3–4 on high.

Is it better to cook chicken on high or low in a crockpot?

Low is preferred for tenderness, but high is faster.

Do you need to cook chicken before putting it in a slow cooker?

No, cooking beforehand isn’t required.

How do you thicken chicken soup in a crockpot?

Add cornstarch slurry, mashed potatoes, or cream.

Can you freeze crockpot chicken soup?

Yes, it freezes well for up to 3 months.

What is the best cut of chicken for crockpot soup?

Chicken thighs or bone-in chicken for flavor, chicken breast for lean protein.

Can I add noodles to chicken soup in a crockpot?

Yes, but add them toward the end to avoid sogginess.

How do you make crockpot chicken soup creamy?

Stir in cream / milk or pureed potatoes.

Can I use frozen chicken for crockpot chicken soup?

Yes, just increase the cooking time.

Final Thoughts

With these 10 best recipes for chicken soup in crockpot, you’ll never run out of options for warm, hearty meals. From easy chicken soup crockpot to gluten free chicken soup crockpot, the versatility of the slow cooker makes it simple to prepare nourishing soups. Whether you prefer noodles, rice, potatoes, or a creamy twist, these recipes are adaptable and family-friendly.

The next time you wonder what to cook for comfort and health, reach for your crockpot and try one of these delicious variations.
